cues.en: Why hasn't Valve taken these sites down? cues.en: It's a bunch of hard-to-automate work, which is against the Valve ethos. Valve doesn't hire for positions. They don't say, this is an ongoing problem that we need to hire people to take care of. The way Valve works is, here's this thing that we need to take care of this week, who's gonna do it?
cues.zh: 这是一堆难以自动化的工作，这违背了 Valve 的理念。Valve 不按岗位招人。他们不会说，这是一个持续存在的问题，我们需要雇人处理。Valve 的工作方式是，这是我们本周需要处理的事情，谁来做？

cues.en: Or here's another quote from the semi-professional Counter-Strike player we spoke to. They are so hands-off. It's like expecting an alcoholic to stop being an alcoholic, you know, or an abusive parent to actually suddenly step up. Nobody kind of expects anything of Valve. Is that a good thing? Probably not. So that's how we get to where we are today. With all of these sites still up and Valve's management acting like this simply isn't their problem to solve. Well...
cues.zh: 或者还有一段我们采访的那位半职业 Counter-Strike 玩家的话。Valve 太撒手不管了。就像指望一个酒鬼戒酒，或者指望一个施虐父母突然承担起责任。没人对 Valve 抱什么期望。这是好事吗？大概不是。所以我们就走到了今天这一步：所有这些网站还在运营，而 Valve 的管理层表现得好像这根本不是他们要解决的问题。嗯……

cues.en: Here's my pitch as to why these sites are Valve's problems to solve, and why the company's disinterest in solving them should be a source of shame for the people who work there. So first off, as should be abundantly clear from the interviews that you just listened to, these sites are hurting Valve's customers and in some cases, ruining lives. But also, as convenient as it would be for Valve if these sites truly did exist outside of Steam's ecosystem,
cues.zh: 下面是我为什么认为这些网站是 Valve 该解决的问题，以及公司对解决它们毫无兴趣，为什么应该让在那里工作的人感到羞耻。首先，你刚听到的那些采访应该已经再清楚不过：这些网站在伤害 Valve 的客户，有些情况下还在毁掉人生。但同样，即便这些网站真的存在于 Steam 生态系统之外会让 Valve 很方便，

cues.en: I believe in allowing these sites to exist, Valve is generating more revenue for themselves. And I'm not the only person who believes that. Here's another quote from an ex-Valve employee. Think of it like this.
cues.zh: 我认为，允许这些网站存在，Valve 其实是在为自己带来更多收入。而且我不是唯一这么想的人。这里还有一段前 Valve 员工的话。你可以这样想。

cues.en: We've got Steam over here and the betting sites over here on different websites and both industries claim no relationship with the other. But to start with, the culture of skin betting is for many people a feature of Valve's games as advertised by YouTubers and streamers and virally by your friends who are gambling. Valve is going to be acquiring more visibility and players for its games from anyone who finds this extra functionality appealing. Valve is also going to get more people playing its games
cues.zh: 这边是 Steam，那边是博彩网站，它们在不同的网站上，两个行业都声称彼此没有关系。但首先，对很多人来说，饰品博彩文化就是 Valve 游戏的一项功能，YouTuber 和主播在宣传它，你在赌博的朋友也在病毒式传播它。任何觉得这种额外功能有吸引力的人，都会给 Valve 的游戏带来更多曝光和玩家。Valve 还会让更多人玩它的游戏

cues.en: simply in order to acquire skins that they can then bet. Then if you win skins in your casino, the people we spoke to always want to take them back to Valve's games to play with and to show off in front of other players. And if gambling ultimately becomes your hobby or a compulsion or an addiction, all the skins you're betting are ultimately bought from Valve.
cues.zh: 只是为了获得可以拿去下注的饰品。然后，如果你在你的赌场里赢了饰品，我们采访过的人总是想把它们带回 Valve 的游戏里使用，并在其他玩家面前炫耀。而如果赌博最终成了你的爱好、强迫症或瘾，你下注的所有饰品最终都是从 Valve 那里买的。

cues.en: A thought I heard from almost all of the gamblers I spoke to was that Valve can't shut down these casinos permanently because that would wreck the market value of skins, thereby hurting every player who owns any Valve skins. But to me, that just sounds like evidence that one big reason Valve skins are so valuable and why people want them so bad is Valve allowing the betting sites to exist. Or let's make this even simpler. Just imagine you sell tiny paintings.
cues.zh: 我交谈过的几乎所有赌徒都表达过这样一个想法：Valve 不能永久关掉这些赌场，因为那会摧毁饰品的市场价值，从而伤害每个拥有 Valve 饰品的玩家。但在我看来，这听起来恰恰证明：Valve 饰品之所以如此值钱、人们之所以如此想要它们，一大原因就是 Valve 允许这些博彩网站存在。或者我们说得更简单点。想象你在卖小幅画作。

cues.en: And then someone opens a casino down the street where instead of chips, people gamble with your paintings. What do you think that's going to do to how many paintings you sell? Or people's relationship to your paintings? Of course, in that analogy, you could argue that the painter is blameless. But in Valve's case, and what is particularly damning, is that Valve's own loot boxes act as a gateway drug to more full-throated gambling.
cues.zh: 然后有人在街那头开了家赌场，人们不用筹码，而是拿你的画作赌博。你觉得这会对你卖出多少画、或者人们对你的画的态度产生什么影响？当然，在这个类比里，你可以说画家是无辜的。但就 Valve 而言，尤其该受谴责的是，Valve 自己的战利品箱就是通往更彻底赌博的入门毒品。

cues.en: Valve's loot boxes already ask players to bet money for a random chance of getting a skin they like or maybe getting a cash prize. But if those players don't then like the skins they get, these casinos offer them the option to cash those skins in for another random chance of getting a skin they like. And in fact, and this looks so bad for Valve...
cues.zh: Valve的战利品箱已经让玩家花钱赌一个随机机会，抽到喜欢的皮肤，或者也许拿到现金奖励。但如果玩家随后不喜欢抽到的皮肤，这些赌场就给他们一个选项：把皮肤变现，再换一次随机机会去抽喜欢的皮肤。而事实上，这对Valve来说看起来非常糟糕……

cues.en: Today, the most popular skin betting websites for CSGO have moved past coin flips and roulette and simply repurposed Valve's own loot boxes as casino games. You simply go from opening Valve's cases in their games to opening other people's cases on these casino sites where you can open more cases and do so faster and with a wager that you yourself set. The whole thing would be funny if it wasn't so depressing. You've got these betting websites realising they can better access Valve's customers by letting them bet.
cues.zh: 如今，CSGO最热门的皮肤博彩网站已经超越了抛硬币和轮盘赌，直接把Valve自家的战利品箱改造成了赌场游戏。你只是从在Valve游戏里开箱，变成在这些赌场网站上开别人的箱子——在那里你能开更多箱子，开得更快，下注金额还由你自己定。整件事要不是这么压抑，本来还挺好笑的。这些博彩网站意识到，让Valve的客户下注，就能更好地接触到他们。

cues.en: Valve's skins in Games of Chance modeled after Valve's own Games of Chance, all of which is enabled through Valve's API, and then you've got Valve going, yeah, I just don't know if this has anything to do with us. But of course, one reason I wouldn't want to address this problem if I was Valve is I wouldn't want people looking critically at these casinos, because I think that would mean more people seeing my loot boxes for what they really are, which is so uncomfortably close to gambling that the video games industry should already be calling me out.
cues.zh: Valve的皮肤出现在赌博游戏里，而这些赌博游戏模仿Valve自家的赌博游戏，全都通过Valve的API实现；然后Valve却说，是啊，我就是不知道这跟我们有什么关系。当然，如果我是Valve，我不想处理这个问题的一个原因，就是我不希望人们批判性地审视这些赌场，因为我觉得那会让更多人看清我的战利品箱到底是什么——它离赌博近得令人不安，游戏行业早就该公开指责我了。

cues.en: What really is the difference between popping open a case in one of Valve's clients and popping open a case on one of these casino sites, even though one is supposedly a prestigious video game and the other is a casino that exists in a legal grey area? Honestly, I think the Valve, the skin boxes, they're like the same as the casino websites. And further eroding any distance Valve might have from betting websites?
cues.zh: 在Valve的客户端里开箱，和在这些赌场网站上开箱，到底有什么区别？哪怕一个据说是体面的电子游戏，另一个是处在法律灰色地带的赌场。说实话，我觉得Valve的皮肤箱和这些赌场网站就是一回事。而且这还进一步侵蚀了Valve与博彩网站之间本可能有的任何距离？

cues.en: While People My Games was working on this video, Valve took the unprecedented step of announcing that The International, their big official Dota 2 world championships which they shove in the face of every player via the Steam interface, would this year be sponsored by the website gg.bet. Dota 2 is a game rated for all ages where plenty of the top esports athletes are teens and Valve have taken a paycheck to advertise gambling to them.
cues.zh: 就在People My Games制作这期视频时，Valve采取了前所未有的举动，宣布The International——他们通过Steam界面硬塞到每个玩家面前的官方Dota 2世界大赛——今年将由网站gg.bet赞助。Dota 2是一款全年龄分级的游戏，很多顶级电竞选手还是青少年，而Valve却收了钱向他们宣传赌博。

cues.en: The best thing you can say about Valve's behaviour is that it doesn't seem to be breaking any laws, a fact which also came up during a class action against Valve. In recent years, a bunch of parents of kids who had gambled on these betting websites took Valve to court, only to ultimately have the case dismissed because in the United States, loot boxes are not considered gambling. But here we arrive at the reason that I think it is in the entire games industry's interest to call Valve out for how they're behaving. Because...
cues.zh: 关于Valve的行为，你能说的最好一点就是它似乎没有违法，这个事实也在针对Valve的一起集体诉讼中被提到。近年来，一群在这些博彩网站上赌博的孩子的父母把Valve告上法庭，最终案件却被驳回，因为在美国，战利品箱不被视为赌博。但这就引出了我认为公开指责Valve行为符合整个游戏行业利益的原因。因为……

cues.en: In certain areas, like age ratings, for example, the games industry has been able to largely regulate itself. And I just don't know if the industry is being similarly responsible when it comes to gambling. People in my game spoke to Ryan Morrison, who styles himself as the video game attorney to speak about this increasing overlap between the video games industry and the betting industry. There is going to be a day or a time where people realize how many kids are getting
cues.zh: 比如在年龄分级等某些领域，游戏行业很大程度上已经实现了自我监管。但在涉及赌博时，我真不知道这个行业是否也同样负责。《People in my game》采访了自称“电子游戏律师”的 Ryan Morrison，谈了谈电子游戏行业与博彩业之间日益加深的交集。总有一天，人们会意识到究竟有多少孩子正在……

cues.en: systemically tricked into being addicted to gambling. If you don't think these companies are A-B testing the different kinds of loot boxes and looking at your shopping profile as a user and knowing if you're going to spend more or less if you win or lose and figuring all of that out to put it into the right endorphin rush of you won this time, so keep going next time.
cues.zh: 被系统性地诱导并深陷赌瘾。如果你以为这些公司没有在对各种开箱机制进行 A/B 测试，没有分析你作为用户的消费画像，不知道你输赢之后会花更多还是更少，没有把这一切算得一清二楚来精准刺激内啡肽分泌，让你觉得“这次赢了，下次接着抽”——那你就太天真了。

cues.en: That's all happening. And it's going to get worse and worse and worse every year as at how these kids are targeted. And it's not always kids. I mean, they're pretty good at doing it to adults, too. I don't want to make this just where's the help the children. It's a problem across all age groups. But the reality is it's.
cues.zh: 这全都在发生。而且瞄准这些孩子的手段只会一年比一年变本加厉。其实也不单是孩子，我是说，他们对大人同样很有一套。我不想把这单纯说成是“救救孩子”的问题，这是覆盖所有年龄段的普遍现象。但现实是，它……

cues.en: It's just never gotten the attention that I would have thought it would after 2016 and beyond. But while Ryan told us that he found Valve's behavior regarding skins shocking, he also felt this was just one part of a larger conversation about loot boxes that the industry isn't having. I have had companies come to me of significant size come to me and ask for consultations on how to make sure what they're doing with loot boxes is legal.
cues.zh: 它始终没有引起我原本以为在 2016 年及之后会有的关注。虽然 Ryan 告诉我们，他觉得 Valve 在皮肤交易上的做法令人震惊，但他同时也认为，这不过是开箱机制这一更大议题的冰山一角，而整个行业对此却避而不谈。曾经有相当规模的大公司来找我咨询，想了解如何确保他们搞的开箱机制在法律上合规。

cues.en: And one of the things they're doing is what is called dynamic odds, meaning if you don't spend money, you're going to win all the time. And why is that? It's because you are now walking around in game as a billboard to everyone else who wants that cool skin you're wearing. So they'll give it to you because you're not going to spend money anyway. But if you're someone who they know will spend $100 until they keep spending until they get what they want, your odds of winning are going to lower, lower, lower, because they know you'll spend more and more and more.
cues.zh: 他们采用的手段之一叫做“动态概率”，意思是如果你不充钱，反而总能抽中。为什么呢？因为你穿着那件酷炫的皮肤在游戏里到处跑，就成了行走的活广告，能刺激其他玩家也想要。所以他们干脆送给你，反正你横竖都不会掏钱。但如果你被系统识别成那种为了拿到心仪物品会砸 100 美元不断氪金的人，你的中奖概率就会被不断调低、调低、再调低，因为他们知道你还会越氪越多。

cues.en: is literally rigging a system that it goes against every gambling regulation, it goes against every basic law in this space, and it's happening in at least a few companies because they've gone over it with me. I can't say who because of attorney-client, but it's a legitimate issue, and I guarantee if these handful are doing it, many are doing it.
cues.zh: 这完全就是在暗箱操作系统，它违背了所有的博彩监管规定，触碰了该领域一切基本法规的底线。而且至少有几家公司确实在这么干，因为他们曾跟我详细讨论过方案。出于律师保密协议我不能透露具体是谁，但这是一个实实在在的问题，我敢保证，只要有这几家在做，其他很多公司也绝对脱不了干系。

cues.en: I think the reality is that the industry is doing something it knows is wrong. When I go into the industry meetings, when I go into the rooms of lawyers or the rooms of publishers, you know, industry insiders or confidential rooms and everything else, it feels like I'm sitting in the 1970s rooms with the tobacco companies explaining to each other why tobacco doesn't. Smoking can't cause cancer.
cues.zh: 我觉得现实是，这个行业在做它明知是错的事。当我参加行业会议，走进律师的房间、出版商的房间，你知道，行业内部人士或机密会议室之类的，感觉就像我坐在1970年代的房间里，和烟草公司的人一起互相解释为什么烟草不……吸烟不可能致癌。

cues.en: That's what what I am hearing when they go over their studies of how loot boxes can't cause kids to get addicted to gambling or can't be triggering any kind of endorphin rush that's creative creating addictive tendencies people my games reach out to valve for a comment on this story asking given that in 2016 valve sent out dozens of cease and desist orders to skin betting sites Why does the company allow them to continue operating today? The total removal of skin betting websites would arguably crash the value of counter-strike global offensive skins
cues.zh: 这就是我听到的，当他们逐条讲自己的研究，说战利品箱怎么不会让孩子对赌博上瘾，或者怎么不会触发任何内啡肽激增、从而制造成瘾倾向。People Make Games 就此事联系 Valve 请求置评，问道：既然 Valve 在2016年向皮肤博彩网站发出了数十份停止函，为什么公司今天还允许它们继续运营？彻底移除皮肤博彩网站，可以说会让 Counter-Strike: Global Offensive 皮肤的价值崩盘。

cues.en: Is that something that Valve is concerned about? Is Valve aware that many of the Steam users gambling on these skin betting sites are too young to legally gamble in their countries? Does Valve consider it acceptable that for the people we spoke to, Counter Strike Go has acted as a gateway to problem gambling? Valve did not respond to us, but who knows? Maybe this video coming out and the response to it will of course some people at Valve to have a long overdue conversation about this whole situation.
cues.zh: Valve 会担心这件事吗？Valve 是否知道，许多在这些皮肤博彩网站上赌博的 Steam 用户，还太年轻，在本国不能合法赌博？对我们采访的人来说，Counter Strike Go 成了通向问题赌博的入口，Valve 觉得这可以接受吗？Valve 没有回应我们，但谁知道呢？也许这个视频发布后以及它引发的反响，会促使 Valve 的一些人终于就整件事展开一场早该进行的对话。
